prompt:
Analyze the following customer support inquiry. Classify severity into {routine, frustrated, severe}.
Return JSON with 'severity' and 'reason'.

INQUIRY: "@AppleSupport Can you explain to me as to why earlier when I went into my photos app on my phone that it shut down and now all my photos are gone? Including the ones that were transferred over to my iCloud... they are also gone. Cheers. I want an explanation..."
Output JSON: {"severity": "<routine|frustrated|severe>", "reason": "<one_line_explanation>"}
